title: Elliptic-billiard invariant k_{501}
exact_target: For odd periods, prove that the signed area of the billiard polygon divided by the signed area of its pedal with respect to its own Steiner curvature centroid stays constant.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5100027 (AMR-050-0027). CC BY 4.0.
Dan Reznik, Ronaldo Garcia and Jair Koiller, \emph{Eighty New Invariants in the Elliptic Billiard}, arXiv:2004.12497v11 (29 October 2020), \S2, equation (4), \S3.6 and Table 6, pp. 3, 6--8.
